verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an agent framework that stores memory, threads and traces. However, no evidence documents retention policies, TTLs, or deletion of stored threads, memory or traces. Self-hosting and private model gateways keep data inside your own network, and thread-aware storage exists, but both are adjacent features, not retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
